column1: # UP K2 5: the line plan, line by line.
# Source: UP International, "K2 5 Line Plan" (K2_5_Line_Plan.pdf, one page),
# Transcribed 2026-10-19 from the drawing: each line and the line it hangs
#   from. A parent that is not a line is where the cascade ends: a riser, or
#   the brake handle. The drawing does not say which riser the stabilo line
#   is fixed to, so it ends at "riser S". Am3-0, a 600 mm piece of D-PRO, is
#   drawn continuing Amain3 to the riser.
# The same in every size: the sheets up-k2-5-K2_5_38/41/44 carry these names.
